propositions: The tickets branch must not trigger any CI workflows via push events, as enforced by adding 'tickets' to the branches-ignore list in all four push-triggered workflows.
An enumerating test that dynamically scans .github/workflows/ for all files ensures no future workflow can regress the invariant by adding a bare push: trigger.
Schedule cron blocks and gerrit-verify.yaml dispatch-only gate remain unchanged, preserving pre-merge validation and scheduled reconciliation cadences.
Adopter documentation across docs/concurrency.md, docs/user-guide.md, and docs/config.md warns against CI triggered by tickets-branch auto-pushes and recommends schedule-based alternatives.
The merged change (commit 69c2ad3252) is a declarative guard; live validation confirmed zero workflow runs on the tickets branch push following the change.
